# Clerky — Perks

Clerky customers get access to a catalogue of third-party startup perks, surfaced in the Perks and Banking tabs of the team dashboard. Clerky publishes no discount on its own legal products.

### Notes

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: this is not a discount on Clerky. Clerky's own pricing page (https://www.clerky.com/pricing, fetched 200) publishes a $819 Company Lifetime Package and $427 pay-per-use incorporation with NO startup discount, free plan or credits of its own. The Perks catalogue is third-party offers redeemed from the Clerky dashboard, and Clerky disclaims control over them: "The companies below all have their own eligibility requirements, which we unfortunately don't have any control over." What I could NOT inspect: the per-perk terms and their individual eligibility rules live behind each partner, and the dashboard itself is account-gated, so the live perk list and amounts could not be confirmed beyond the banking examples named in the help article. No Clerky-side eligibility rule (age, funding, region) is published. Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records. This entry was NOT independently re-audited, so the evidence quote may be a close paraphrase rather than the vendor's exact wording. Re-read the source before relying on precise phrasing. Re-confirmed 2026-09-16. This is a third-party perks catalogue, not a Clerky discount - listed offers include "$5000 in AWS credits, valid for 2 years" and "6 months free" (Xero). Clerky states plainly that eligibility for each is set by the third party, so no single amount or rule can be attributed to Clerky.
